en: The image shows a sepia-toned historic postcard depicting a large institutional building with multiple floors, dormer windows, and cupolas on the roof. The street adjacent to the building appears quiet, with only a single pedestrian visible. The overall design is very orderly and typical of early 20th-century German architecture. The text on the card reads 'Frankenberg i. Sa. - Unteroffiziersschule,' indicating the building's function as a non-commissioned officers' school.
